description: Fixed taxonomy of findings threadlight-governed-actions can emit: consequential-action inventory, mediation-path coverage, enforcement, approval, output payload-freedom, audit-trail completeness, pin integrity, GitHub Copilot coding-agent change-plane posture, and operational alerting. Agent Hooks is cooperative/alpha and never a security boundary; conformance is never certification; not-verified never becomes pass on its own — 'unsupported' is a reason_code the assessor records, never a status.

findings.summary: A consequential action (write/external-egress/irreversible) is invocable but not present in the declared action inventory.
findings.remediation: Declare the action (name, consequence class, reversibility, execution modes) so it can be mediated and audited; do not leave consequential actions undeclared.

findings.summary: A declared action is missing metadata (consequence class, reversibility, or compensation reference) needed for downstream policy and approval decisions.
findings.remediation: Complete the action's declaration with an explicit consequence class, reversibility flag, and compensation reference where reversible=false.

findings.summary: A discovered execution path reaches a consequential action without passing through any interceptor/policy seam.
findings.remediation: Route the path through the declared pre-action seam (Agent Hooks or an equivalent interceptor) before the action executes.

findings.summary: Path tracing could not conclusively determine whether a route to a consequential action is mediated (e.g. dynamic dispatch or subagent delegation); recorded not-verified rather than assumed covered.
findings.remediation: Add a deterministic probe case or static reference that lets the assessor confirm coverage instead of leaving it ambiguous.

findings.summary: A path without a direct interceptor seam instead relies on an equivalent compensating control (e.g. a provider-hosted tool allow-list) that has not been independently verified.
findings.remediation: Provide evidence (references, live verification, or a probe result) for the claimed equivalent control, or add a direct seam.

findings.summary: No enforcement seam (Agent Hooks or a declared equivalent) is wired for at least one execution mode a consequential action runs under.
findings.remediation: Wire the enforcement seam for every execution mode the action supports, including subagent and provider-hosted-tool modes.

findings.summary: Agent Hooks is cooperative and can be bypassed by a caller that skips the hook, and no compensating control (allow-list, network policy, provider-side restriction) was found for that bypass surface.
findings.remediation: Add a compensating control for the bypass surface; do not rely on Agent Hooks alone as the security boundary.

findings.summary: An action flagged approval_required has no verifiable approval-redemption evidence in the audit trail prior to execution.
findings.remediation: Record an approval_redemption_hash in the audit trail before the action is permitted to execute, and verify it is checked at the enforcement seam.

findings.summary: Evidence, audit records, or manifest content captured by the assessor contains prompt/argument/output/secret payload material instead of hashes or structural references.
findings.remediation: Replace payload content with hashes/references (e.g. input_hash/output_hash) so evidence stays payload-free.

findings.summary: A consequential-action invocation has no corresponding payload-free audit record (event_id, decision, and hash chain), making the decision unauditable after the fact.
findings.remediation: Emit one payload-free audit record per consequential-action decision, including policy_hash/action_hash and delivery_status.

findings.summary: A pinned dependency, specification, or probe-suite version referenced by the assessment no longer matches the version/hash recorded at capture time (pin drift).
findings.remediation: Re-pin to the current version/hash and re-run the assessment, or restore the originally pinned version.

findings.summary: Workflow files that can modify the repository or trigger a deployment (including GitHub Copilot coding-agent workflows) are not enumerated with content hashes in the change-plane inventory.
findings.remediation: Enumerate every change-plane workflow file with its repository-relative path and content hash.

findings.summary: A change-plane identity (CI/CD, GitHub Copilot coding agent, or similar) could not be confirmed to have least-privilege scoping evidence.
findings.remediation: Record the identity's kind and scope evidence, and narrow its permissions to only what the change-plane workflow requires.

findings.summary: A branch the change-plane deploys from lacks required review/status-check gating evidence.
findings.remediation: Enable branch protection (required reviews and status checks) on every branch the change-plane can deploy from.

findings.summary: A change-plane workflow references secrets/tokens in a way the assessor could not confirm stays out of logs and artifacts.
findings.remediation: Confirm secret handling (masking, scoped injection) for the workflow, or restructure it so secrets never reach logs/artifacts.

findings.summary: Evidence suggests the same identity/session that authored a change-plane action could also approve or merge it, without an independent reviewer.
findings.remediation: Require an independent reviewer/approver distinct from the change author before the change-plane action can proceed.

findings.summary: A previously hashed change-plane workflow or policy artifact no longer matches its current content, so cached conformance claims about it are stale.
findings.remediation: Re-hash the workflow/policy artifact and re-verify any conformance claim that depended on it.

findings.summary: No alerting/notification path was found for enforcement failures, hook errors, or audit delivery_status failures, so governance-relevant failures go unmonitored.
findings.remediation: Add alerting on enforcement errors, non-delivered audit records, and abnormal interceptor_duration_ms so failures are noticed rather than silently accumulating.
